needs.premise: Two nested invocation identities, abstract shell stages and one GC scan interval; stop, physical accounting, native disposition and finalizer guard are qualified premises; not arbitrary recursion, actual malloc/free or C weak-memory execution
19 conditional declarations: publication/commit/escape rejection, canonical-state Step/Trace preservation, invocation-slot separation; not all QNT actions or source-to-C memory simulation

Acquire physical storage/charge receipt and a registered initialization descriptor privately; initialize link/refcount/length/header/handle and phase-defined mark state plus FOREIGN defaults before shared list admission; unknown allocator or accounting outcome retains exact backing/charge debt; never expose raw private body to scanner or release

Register procedure, tags, arguments, ancestor/result/error root cells before every allocating entry; acquire relocated values after allocation; FOREIGN scan is opaque so dynamic tags/dependencies need permanent proof or explicit handles; RC data ownership and nonzero-processor scan/teardown closure remain imported gaps

Capture and lease closure identity before any collecting/reentrant entry; replace process-global c_closure_self for supported concurrent closures with per-invocation identity; TLS alone does not handle same-thread nesting; marker belongs to original activation/processor, invalidity is permanent

Generated C boundary catches each supported nonlocal exit at the original owner activation; stable record pointer predates setjmp, mutable ownership/progress lives outside changed nonvolatile automatic locals; publish error/root or destination marker, stop writers, transfer initialization duty and invalidate escaped markers before propagation; never hold admission lock across allocation/callback/unwind

Completed body and result root precede one canonical pending-to-wrapper control publication carrying invocation generation and release right; field writes and notification are not commit; before commit escrow retains native right, after commit unwind cannot roll it back; authoritative query after unknown response never reexecutes production or commit

All GC/explicit/rollback/teardown release dispatchers consult canonical right; stopped safe-shell initialization may park without owner-return wait; unknown writer/layout/root/commit cannot authorize takeover or refund; native borrowers drain before disposal, result/root/code readers and descendants before metadata/ticket reuse

Actual C release/acquire or lock refinement for physical list/root registration, shell admission, collector root mutation, canonical control and unwind drain; raw body readers excluded until control acquisition; actual builtin setjmp ABI and generation reuse require toolchain-specific evidence

Publish a valid rooted FOREIGN shell with safe default fields or keep private storage unexposed before list admission; exact native duty stays in escrow until canonical commit; partial initialization requires known stopped writer, safe shell and rooted inputs; arbitrary linked/uninitialized current C state is not recoverable by assertion

One result slot and invocation generation per actual call, independent of GC epoch; late native-only stores add no managed root and may not overwrite committed slots; body initialization/root registration precede canonical custody commit, and query cannot replay production or allocate a duplicate wrapper

Every nested callback has its own reserved record/result slot, protected procedure before marker allocation and a complete ancestor chain; respect same-owner C stack, processor marker and invalidation; child errors/delete cannot free active marker/RC/code/native dependencies

Canonical resource authority transfers at one known commit while root coverage overlaps; native borrowers drain before destructive disposal, receipt/root/code readers and descendants drain before metadata/ticket reuse; result observers do not pin collector view buffers; unknown outcome retains exact custody

Actual C11 release/acquire or lock refinement for writer gate, immutable descriptor publication, trace receipt, canonical slot/custody commit and reentry; root relocation is authorized mutation, not a seqlock excuse for data races; ABI/platform mapping and reclamation wrap remain open

shellCosts.removedWork: Eliminate published uninitialized FOREIGN bodies in admitted cohort
shellCosts.bound: 3 logical default-field initializations plus final field writes; one list-admission decision
shellCosts.addedCost: Metadata/phase validity and initialization lease; machine-store count not inferred
shellCosts.condition: Requires replacing allocator publication and guarded release/read paths; current source has no such guarantee

shellCosts.bound: At least 1 procedure root per callback, plus ancestor/result/error/argument/tag cells actually live
shellCosts.addedCost: O(d+R) live root cells for depth d and additional R cells; root scan and reload costs
shellCosts.condition: Current RC coverage and teardown for every processor must qualify; no C-stack conservative-root assumption

shellCosts.removedWork: Remove shared closure-self identity from admitted concurrent callback path
shellCosts.bound: One captured closure token and code/RC lease per invocation
shellCosts.addedCost: Entry adaptation and stack restoration on each nested callback
shellCosts.condition: TLS alone is insufficient for deferred reread after same-thread reentry; ABI support not proved

shellCosts.removedWork: Avoid duplicate wrapper production or rollback after lost response
shellCosts.bound: At most 1 successful result/right commit per invocation; zero additional production on query
shellCosts.addedCost: Immutable commit record, acquire read, generation checks and right-aware pointer adapter
shellCosts.condition: Abstract control publication count, not machine atomic count; no lost external effect recovery implied

shellCosts.removedWork: Cover exits that skip lexical SFUN_END and marker kill
shellCosts.bound: One settled record per escaped activation; work O(k) for k escaped frames
shellCosts.addedCost: Stable records, typed exit tags, owner-only guard, root/child/code lease drain
shellCosts.condition: Cannot reinstate dead C frames, silently convert continuation escape into Scheme exception or cross arbitrary library frames

shellCosts.removedWork: Permit known stopped safe-shell duties to park across GC
shellCosts.bound: Eligible owner-return wait removed; added root/metadata scan, stop and handoff costs
shellCosts.addedCost: Pre-backed escrow/root budget and eventual service dispatch
shellCosts.condition: Unknown writer/layout/root/physical allocation still blocks this admission; no guaranteed pause bound or speedup

shellCosts.removedWork: Keep native right unique through pre/postcommit error
shellCosts.bound: 0 refunds from unknown native disposition or lost notification
shellCosts.addedCost: Borrower/reader/descendant counts and code lifetime; retained failed/unknown backing
shellCosts.condition: No replay of release on scalar error; record retirement and actual physical free are separate

shellCosts.removedWork: Single native backing/right shared by escrow and wrapper, not copied at commit
shellCosts.bound: Peak=max_t(H(t)+P(t)+N(t)+Q(t)); every live physical backing counted once
shellCosts.addedCost: P: actual pools incl shell/root/commit records; Q: retained unknown backing not already in H/P/N
shellCosts.condition: Current FOREIGN requests 9W logical words; when W=pointer=8, aligned_aux requests 87 bytes before allocator overhead; marker requests 71/79 bytes for 1/2 elements; no peak reduction proved

shellCosts.removedWork: Reuse one root/init/result/exit service across native constructors and callbacks
shellCosts.bound: 0 retired production routes today; candidate replacement families listed in source matrix
shellCosts.addedCost: Scheme semantics/FrameSpec emitters, modern C service and source/memory refinement required
shellCosts.condition: Zig adds no demonstrated incremental elimination of these correctness duties; no person-day proxy

shellCosts.removedWork: Avoid repeated production, unsafe replay and reverse waits where admitted
shellCosts.bound: Positive latency benefit iff removed wait/repeated work > root+guard+publication+reclaim work on same path
shellCosts.addedCost: Physical extra bytes must fit reserved budget; quarantine needs a physical admission bound or may grow without bound
shellCosts.condition: Correctness capability established conditionally; runtime frequencies, timings and whole-round peak unmeasured

nodes.labelText: Reserve invocation + physical budget\nprotect procedure / input roots
Capture closure identity + original owner\nallocate marker, reload roots
Private backing + charge receipt\nknown layout, init lease
Defaults before list admission\nright-aware scan / cleanup / pointer access
Body complete + result rooted\nescrow still owns native right
One canonical result / right commit\nquery by invocation generation
Owner exit guard\nnormal / error / escaping continuation
Known stopped writer\nservice retains init duty and roots
Stable root locations; collector relocates values\nreload before owner reentry
Unknown stop / layout / allocation / commit\nretain exact debt; no replay or refund
Native borrowers drain -> disposal\nreaders / descendants -> metadata reclaim
SysML authority -> ASCENT\nQNT histories + Lean conditional laws

callers.actualChain: Still allocator may collect, acquire physical storage then link before caller body fill; mark scratch set by setup_still_objs_to_scan
callers.hazard: Current body-before-next-allocation rule assumes phase ordering, not independent-scanner publication
callers.replacement: Typed safe-shell allocator: prepare charge/storage privately, initialize descriptor and defaults, then one guarded list admission

callers.actualChain: Three FOREIGN words tags/release_fn/ptr are written then *obj=r; null maps to false
callers.hazard: Those four assignments do not atomically transfer disposal authority or root result
callers.replacement: Root inputs and safe shell; canonical side control is authoritative, external pointer access requires committed state

callers.actualChain: Pointer conversion reads tags/ptr; release reads fn, clears fn/ptr then calls arbitrary native function
callers.hazard: A partially initialized or precommit shell must not enter either legacy path
callers.replacement: Replace/gate pointer borrow and all release origins before safe partial shells become admissible

callers.actualChain: RC data scanned, FOREIGN body opaque; still sweep/teardown releases FOREIGN, cleanup_rc frees chain
callers.hazard: Opaque scan does not protect tags; RC addref cannot survive unconditional cleanup_rc
callers.replacement: Root descriptors and still-domain phase ownership; release-right-aware sweep, teardown drain or physical transfer

callers.actualChain: make_vector with false may allocate/collect before procedure copy; source explicitly flags missing root protection
callers.hazard: Rooting the newly returned marker is too late to protect proc_or_false
callers.replacement: Reserve invocation/root cells first; protect procedure then allocate and reload; failure creates no live marker

callers.actualChain: Generated C closure sets global c_closure_self then converter later reads it; source TODO requests thread local
callers.hazard: Concurrent closure identity can be overwritten; same-thread reentry also needs captured identity
callers.replacement: Explicit captured closure token plus RC/code lease and nested record stack; raw ABI-preserving trampoline redesign remains open

callers.actualChain: Scheme generator emits SFUN entry/call/conversion/error/end; END kills marker then propagates
callers.hazard: A throw inside call/conversion bypasses lexical END; temp1..4 error reentry can nest
callers.replacement: Scheme emits explicit exit descriptors; C guarded boundary covers normal, conversion-error and escaping continuation exits

callers.actualChain: ___call catches trampoline exit, rethrows nonmatching destination/error; ___run kills marker only after call returns normally
callers.hazard: Skipped C activations need custody settlement; live outer target marker must not be invalidated
callers.replacement: Settle only escaped records, preserve matching target and outer roots; no cross-thread or dead-frame return

callers.actualChain: C cleanup macro is lexical only; TRY restores catcher after jump; builtin setjmp may be selected
callers.hazard: Automatic changed nonvolatile locals cannot be recovery ledger; cleanup macro is not universal finally
callers.replacement: Stable pre-setjmp record handle, typed exit result and bounded no-callback settlement; compiler builtin semantics independently qualified

callers.actualChain: RC vector holds moving procedure; tcltk_call returns allocated C string to Tcl_SetResult with release_string; delete releases vector/RC
callers.hazard: Scheme outcome, C-string delivery and Tcl ownership are separate endpoints; command delete can invalidate backing
callers.replacement: Pin invocation/RC/code; explicit result/error adapter and string custody; arbitrary cross-Tcl continuation exits not admitted

callers.actualChain: Conversions may directly call release_fn; message/process/accept have distinct existing failure gaps
callers.hazard: New wrapper service cannot coexist with independent destructive rollback or reinterpret unknown as retry
callers.replacement: Origin-specific canonical right claim and typed effects; prior three constructor defects remain open
